paragraphs.text: Terashi (tair-ASH-ee / teh-RAH-shee) is a kami from Kamigawa . It is the great kami of the sun.

Terashi's appearance defies description. Its most significant feature is a floating giant glowing ball resembling the sun but less bright. Around this ball is a black skeletal framework, underneath which is a giant face with sharp teeth and glowing eyes. Giant glowing lanterns float in the air around the central part, with long orange ribbons evoking flames hanging down to the ground.

Terashi was one of the favored kami of Takeshi Konda , and a shrine to the Sun Kami was set up in Eiganjo . However, when Kyodai was taken from the spirit realm, Terashi's shrine was replaced by one erected for Takeshi's immortality.
